  • grc-card-b.png (Design B, "Controlled stack": stacked controlled documents with a check)
  • grc-card-c.png (Design C, "Audit seal": large watermark seal behind the text)
  • sizes.png (each design at 552 and 340 px wide, safe area dashed)
  • reference-cleanlanguage.png (layout reference)
  • grc-card-a.html, grc-card-b.html, grc-card-c.html (source HTML of each design)
